_comment: Employers read by tools/ats_search.py. Add an employer only after a live test shows the feed is really theirs: some systems answer 200 for any slug. Entry shapes: {"company": "Name", "ats": "greenhouse|lever|ashby|smartrecruiters", "slug": "board-slug"}; Workday adds "tenant", "wd" (the number in wdN) and "site", plus an optional "search" to narrow a large tenant; Oracle Recruiting Cloud uses "ats": "oracle" with "host" and "site" (e.g. CX_1). A job board is one entry too: {"company": "Eluta", "ats": "eluta", "slug": "eluta", "place": "<city>", "queries": ["<title>"]} (eluta.ca, Canadian jobs; hits are leads). Companies in your watchlist note with a recognised board URL are added at run time.
